stops.note: originally an everyday steamed maize dish; applied to music as a term for its humble, 'mixed' style
Zulu 'steamed maize bread', implying everyday fare; Mahlathini and the Mahotella Queens made it famous
stops.meaning: a South African township music genre blending traditional and jazz styles

current_meaning: a style of South African popular music blending Zulu vocal harmonies with jazz and dance rhythms
